					impassable = no
					is_coastal = yes
					free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes }
				}
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = 1 instant_build = yes }
			}
			navy_experience = 25
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}

}
